purpose: Frame a formal choice between whether something is true or not.
keywords: Plain clause + か否か; N / な-adjective + であるか否か
I will say tomorrow whether I will participate.
We will investigate whether it is genuine.
First, let’s discuss whether it is necessary.
formation: Plain clause + か否か; N / な-adjective + であるか否か
restrictions: Often embedded in a decision or investigation.
mistake: 否か is read いなか here, not ひか.
